selection_rule.alignment: Rigid least-squares fit using all 194 corresponding target C-alpha atoms; no binder atoms
selection_rule.completeness: Exact target sequence and all 194 finite target CA coordinates required
selection_rule.ranking: Among eligible samples, maximize 0.8*ipTM + 0.2*pTM; tie -> lowest sample index
selection_rule.no_eligible_samples: Case fails; no fallback to a rejected sample
selection_rule.scope: Identical rule for positive, negative and novel cases; no binder geometry or epitope used for selection
selection_rule.rationale: Target distortion made global-frame pose validation unreliable in a previous control. The 2 A scale matches the existing structural-screen tolerance; this is a new heuristic, not a validated physical boundary.

conditions.haf: AlphaFold human P02786 native 190-383, same conserved-core alignment
conditions.maf: AlphaFold mouse Q62351 native 192-385, same conserved-core alignment

interpretation_rules.human_controls: Record whether positive interface recovery and presumed-negative confidence behavior persist on both human conformations. Failure makes mouse interpretation additionally confounded.
interpretation_rules.mouse_controls: No known mouse-binding positive control is available in this panel; human control labels do NOT transfer to mouse.
interpretation_rules.selection: Same target-integrity filter and confidence selection; no alternate seeds. Report all three samples.
interpretation_rules.no_binary_crossreactivity_call: Neither high nor low predicted scores establish or rule out mouse binding. AF monomer targets have no experimentally validated bound conformation or full glycan/dimer screen here.

preparation_scope: Raw prediction comparison only; no mouse geometry qualification, pKa, or post-minimization rescue is performed.
